March 2014 Guest Pinner / Dyan is a Canadian stay at home mom to two boys, J and K, who also teaches piano out of her home. She enjoys doing a variety of crafts, playing video games, reading, cooking, and spending time with her family.  

Dyan began writing her blog And Next Comes L in early 2013 and blogs primarily about sensory and light table activities, quiet books, and unique music activities for kids.  

Visit her at www.andnextcomesl.com / by The Organized Parent

When we arrived at our lake home this week, it was already dark.  About 11:00 P.M., we heard a loud honking sound coming from the lake.  I quickly realized it was Trumpeter Swans calling.  I was hoping they would stay around so I could photograph them.  The next morning, I went down to the lake and saw these two swans serenely swimming toward our dock.
